Good morning. I'm Tom, and I'm the data analyst on your account. Let's look at September. First, traffic. How much traffic did the website get? A lot: about eighty thousand visits. Most of it came from Google, and a little from Instagram. Now, leads. How many leads did the campaigns bring? Only four hundred, and that is not many for eighty thousand visits. So the conversion rate is low, half a percent. Here is the insight: the form on the website has twelve questions. That is too many. People start the form and then they leave. My advice is simple: make the form shorter, with only a few questions.

Hi, it's Priya again. I work for an online store that sells kitchen products. Last month we had a lot of visitors: about fifty thousand. Many of them looked at the products, and around five thousand put something in the cart. But only a few hundred people bought. So where is the problem? We looked at the funnel step by step, and we found it: a lot of people leave on the payment page. The page asks for too much information, and it is very slow on the phone. That was our insight. We don't need more traffic. We need a better payment page.
